subject: A young Tamil woman in a traditional Kanchipuram silk saree drawing a white rice-flour kolam in a Chettinad courtyard, with a brass oil lamp and a calm pet cat nearby

setting.place: Chettinad, Tamil Nadu, India; a traditional merchant house courtyard with carved Burmese teak pillars, Athangudi tiles, lime-plastered walls, and a central open-to-sky courtyard
setting.time_of_day: early morning during Margazhi, just before sunrise

lighting: Soft, cool, diffused dawn light with a faint mist; warm light from a small brass oil lamp
style: photorealistic cinematic documentary, historically grounded details, natural textures, candid everyday moment, restrained color grading

motion.subject_motion: The woman carefully draws the kolam with small, natural hand movements; the cat takes a few slow steps; a hanging leaf and the edge of the saree move slightly in the morning breeze; the oil-lamp flame flickers naturally.
motion.camera_move: A slow, stable dolly-in from the wide courtyard view toward the woman and kolam, without changing the scene or character appearance.
